Question 21(a) [2 marks]: Why might the producer have chosen selective distribution for her products?
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
A producer of gourmet ice-creams chooses selective distribution for her products.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 2):
2 marks: States a reason for the producer's decision to use selective distribution
1 marks: Provides some relevant information

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
The producer does not have the resources to produce large quantities of ice-cream to distribute more intensively.

ANSWERS COULD INCLUDE (the student does not need every point):
• more customers/sales than exclusive distribution hence higher profits
• not large enough scale producer / lack production capacity for intensive distribution
• smaller output than intensive, maintain control for high quality
• smaller than intensive, maintain more exclusive image.
